claim: Statistical law assigns NSS coordination to ACT-01 and designated sector producers.
implication: Authority exists, but operational coordination must be evidenced.

claim: MoU requires ACT-02 microdata and metadata within 90 days; last year only tables were sent.
implication: Data-sharing compliance and metadata are weak.

claim: Two maize estimates are 4.8m and 4.2m tonnes for the same season without definitions or revisions.
implication: Reconciliation and provenance are required before modelling.

claim: Satellite classifier reported 86% accuracy on 600 labelled fields in three accessible districts.
implication: Promising pilot evidence is not national fitness evidence.

claim: Two varieties had higher mean yields under controlled water at trial sites.
implication: Trial efficacy does not establish adoption outcomes.

claim: Food-security alerts are due six weeks before the annual survey result.
Holdings, parcels, extension forms and survey records lack common identifiers.
implication: Record linkage is a major methodological risk.

claim: Geospatial project has eight months of funding and one analyst.
implication: Sustainability and key-person dependency are critical.
